final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS average_group_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS average_group_gb_per_minute FROM grouped
